note: Measured, not aspirational. On 2026-08-21, after the in-place unescape and bidi-reorder scan views landed, the shipped engine (configs/default-rules.json + the default detector registry) scored 38/38 = 100% detection and 5/21 = 23.8095% false positives on this corpus. The floor is that detection rate rounded DOWN to 4dp and the ceiling that FP rate rounded UP to 4dp, so the gate cannot fail against the run that set it -- and nothing looser: one missed malicious case takes detection to 37/38 = 97.37% (fails), one more quarantined benign case takes FP to 6/21 = 28.57% (fails). The detection floor is now 1.0, so every malicious case in the corpus is load-bearing: any regression, and any new case the engine misses, fails this gate until it is fixed or recorded as a known_gap. The five false positives are all recorded gaps in manifest.json -- the ceiling exists to stop them growing, not to bless them. Move these only after measuring a real change, and say so in CHANGELOG.md. Tightening them is the point; loosening them to make a red build green is how a gate stops meaning anything.
